_readme: S750, the cheap piles (2026-11-28). Plan s750a files the reading state_course_not_on_page (kb/_program_named_gaps.py, S748) where the committed capture finds a state-listed course on no line of the program's own page. The reading's fires are wrong about 4 times in 100, so each row is checked against a free read of its own page before it is planned: this read prints the page so a session and the plan's second reader can see whether any line prints the course. No model call, nothing written. Madera Elementary Teacher Education A.A.-T 39810: POLSC C1000 and POLSC C1000H. Two loads: the filed address with the data its own scripts fetch, and the entry as the capture reads it (cq_view, catalog 6; the filed address ends in the entry's id, 1074, and the section in the address is a placeholder, so the read reports the node as not among its siblings).

questions.polsc: Whether the Elementary Teacher Education A.A.-T entry prints POLSC C1000 or POLSC C1000H on any line, which political science course it prints, and its total.

outside_hosts.curriqunet.com: the college's own catalog (madera.curriqunet.com), served on its catalog vendor's domain; the page's own scripts fetch the entry's text from it
